title: gymnocalycium × intermedium
intro: Gymnocalycium × intermedium, commonly known as the intermediate pincushion cactus, is a hybrid species of flowering plant in the cactus family. It is known for its unique, pincushion-like appearance and is often used in gardening and landscaping due to its low-maintenance requirements and attractive appearance. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system, likely due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Gymnocalycium × intermedium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
